name: Young Crocolisk Skin
summary: In the Wetlands, young crocolisks provide hides for trade from Menethil Harbor. Their softer skins are cured by local tanner James Halloran and shipped to distant ports.

sections.title: Tanning and Trade in the Marshes
sections.body: Menethil Harbor sends marsh goods to distant ports from the western coast of Khaz Modan. The town’s resident tanner, James Halloran, cures hides among its most lucrative exports. Full-grown crocolisks have thick, tough scales, while their young provide softer leather that is easier to work. The delicate skins are in high demand, so Halloran depends on local hunters and passing travelers to search the boggy marshes just outside town and keep his curing racks stocked.

faq.q: Why does James Halloran want skins from young crocolisks specifically?
faq.answer: Young crocolisks have softer hides that are easier to work and cure than the thick, tough scales of mature crocolisks. Their leather is in high demand across sea trade routes.

faq.q: Where can young crocolisks be found?
faq.answer: Young Wetlands Crocolisks live in the waterways, bogs, and marshes just outside Menethil Harbor in the western Wetlands.

faq.q: Who else hunts these crocolisks for the harbor?
faq.answer: Einar, a local hunter, regularly brings crocolisk hides to James Halloran’s leatherworking business, though one tracker cannot always meet demand.

faq.q: Where are these cured skins shipped?
faq.answer: James Halloran’s finished goods leave Menethil Harbor aboard merchant vessels bound for major ports and markets across the Eastern Kingdoms and beyond.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can stalk the muddy edges of the Wetlands for crocolisk hides to supply Menethil Harbor’s leather trade.
